title: Improving Commonsense Bias Classification by Mitigating the Influence of Demographic Terms
findings: The study measured the polarization of religious terms, finding a positive polarity for Christianity (0.08) and negative polarities for Hinduism (-0.13) and Islam (-0.08), with an overall negative perception for the religion category (-0.04). The 'Religion' class, having a smaller dataset size, showed lower baseline classifier performance. The proposed debiasing and augmentation techniques (IHTA) significantly improved classification accuracy for the religion category, outperforming standard methods by up to 11.27%.
